articles.title: Oops! Opening the Wrong Box Unlocked a 123-Year-Old Secret
articles.summary: A retired teacher was just organizing old boxes when she found a long-lost anti-slavery scroll from 1847. Signed by 116 ministers, it had been missing for over a century. Talk about a lucky accident!

articles.title: A Secret Code in a 130-Year-Old Dress? The Answer Will Surprise You!
articles.summary: For ten years, nobody could crack the weird code found in a hidden pocket of an 1880s silk dress. Turns out, it wasn't spy stuff—it was a weather report from 1888!

articles.title: BTS Members Freeze in Shock When Drake Drops Their Name in a New Song!
articles.summary: V and J-Hope were jamming to Drake's new song "Make Them Cry" when they heard him rap about BTS. Their jaws dropped—and the internet can't get enough of their reaction!
